purpose: Make exact prompts, expected goal regions, complete robot behavior, endpoints, successes, and failure stages visible without a success-montage selection bias.

recording.future_pilots: Record a viewport video for every valid pilot episode. Preserve WAM future videos or latents separately when the released inference interface exposes them.
recording.existing_droid_v1: Select source episodes deterministically from the complete 160-episode trajectory index, replay their saved HDF5 actions with recorded environment configuration, and validate the replay against the original endpoint and outcome before publication.
recording.replay_failure: If replay changes the requested relation, binary result, failure stage, or final bowl-relative lateral displacement by more than 0.02 m, reject the replay and rerun the exact policy, prompt, and seed with viewport recording enabled.
recording.raw_media_git_policy: Do not commit unbounded raw MP4 collections. Commit selection manifests, hashes, posters, compact publication clips, and the reproducible renderer.

prospective_selection_roles_per_model.rule: Lowest pilot seed with a valid LEFT success, ordered by direct, short, outcome, then contrastive prompt.
Lowest pilot seed with a valid RIGHT success, ordered by direct, short, outcome, then contrastive prompt.
Lowest pilot seed whose last verified stage is pickup without entering the requested goal, using protocol prompt order then LEFT before RIGHT.
Lowest paired seed and LEFT-before-RIGHT direction where direct and contrastive prompts have discordant binary outcomes; retain both episodes.

missing_category_policy: Render an explicit no-qualifying-example record rather than substituting a hand-picked clip.
existing_v1_timing_disclosure: All v1 outcomes were known when this deterministic retrospective selection rule was frozen. The complete 160-episode gallery remains the evidence-bearing population.
clip_storyboard: 0-2 s: model, arena, exact prompt, requested relation, and expected goal-region diagram
full rollout: viewport video with requested region and actual object path overlay
end card: final endpoint, binary result, and last verified progress stage
WAM optional: synchronized generated future versus the subsequently executed horizon, labeled as horizon-level rather than full-episode prediction

exports.article_and_x: H.264 yuv420p MP4, 16:9, 20-35 seconds where the full episode permits
exports.linkedin: Square H.264 MP4 or carousel poster
exports.accessibility: Burned-in prompt and outcome text, separate VTT captions, poster alt text, and no color-only success encoding
exports.gallery: Filterable local HTML backed by JSON and CSV media indexes
